selected_families.name: Human preference
selected_families.measures: Pairwise user preferences aggregated into a rating.
selected_families.limits: Preference and style are distinct from factual correctness. Exact category/adjustment, dated vote cutoff, interval and votes matter.
selected_families.practical_implication: Use for candidate assistant experience; test correctness and your tasks separately.

selected_families.name: General capability composite
selected_families.measures: Weighted combination of ten evaluations. Categories: Agents30%, Coding20%, Scientific Reasoning20%, General30%.
selected_families.limits: Primarily English and text; different metrics transformed for a composite, weights reflect evaluator priorities. Not universal IQ; do not compare across index versions without recomputation.
selected_families.practical_implication: A shortlist signal, followed by task-specific evaluation and cost.

selected_families.name: Coding and terminal execution
selected_families.measures: Whether agents complete repository/terminal tasks under checked test criteria.
selected_families.limits: Model plus agent environment; compare harness/version/tools/budget. SWE bash-only1.x vs2.x are not automatically compatible.
selected_families.practical_implication: Closer to repair/engineering workflows than a chat coding preference score, but not a guarantee of shipping a whole app.

selected_families.name: Factual reliability and abstention
selected_families.measures: Recall and calibrated refusal over 6,000 questions. Accuracy is correct/all questions; published hallucination rate is incorrect/(incorrect+partial+not-attempted), not incorrect/all answers.
selected_families.limits: Benchmark-specific denominator and synthetic question-generation/judge dependencies; lower hallucination alone can coexist with more abstention.
selected_families.practical_implication: Look for correct answers and appropriate admissions of uncertainty, separately.

selected_families.name: Document synthesis
selected_families.measures: Find, connect and reason over100 questions with long documents(10k–100k tokens).
selected_families.limits: Grader uses LLM equality checking; context-window capacity alone says nothing about successful synthesis.
selected_families.practical_implication: Evaluate actual long documents and evidence integration at your required length.
